title: Recast the national digital architect as an institutional function
requirements:
- Describe a multidisciplinary, institutionally mandated architecture function rather than an individual
- Address recurrent funding, seniority and independence safeguards for the function
- Ask countries to document decisions held, advised on, escalation routes and objection criteria
- Consolidate role content into 4.5 or cross-reference 4.2.4 and 4.5.2
- Consider a transitional composition/integration function that assembles the national stack before a national curator exists
- Address continuity, succession and bottleneck risk
- Give criteria for choosing its institutional location
- Require written, transparent decisions with an appeal or escalation route when the function says no
